tables.label: Dry-end run setups
tables.meaning: One row per run setup, the fact table: up to three orders (lanes) across the web, the setup's clock, its feet, square feet and every waste line of its own.
tables.name: setups

tables.label: Order lanes
tables.meaning: One row per order lane of a setup: one customer's slice of the web, its sheet size, outs, cuts, cutoff knife and waste boards.
tables.name: setup_orders

tables.label: The downtime log
tables.meaning: One row per stop: the run setup that holds it, its kind (Maintenance, Operator, Scheduled; a power outage counts as External), place, reason, seconds and the operator's comment.
tables.name: stops

tables.label: Reject lines
tables.meaning: One row per reject line: one lane's rejected sheets by category and reason, with where on the board as attributes (liner, side).
tables.name: rejects

tables.label: Wet-end paper runs
tables.meaning: One row per paper run: consecutive setups on one grade and web width, its totals exact sums of its setups.
tables.name: wet_ends

tables.label: Roll stock
tables.meaning: One row per roll of paper fed into a paper run: its stand, paper, feet fed, peel and core.
tables.name: rolls

tables.label: Shifts
tables.meaning: One row per 480-minute shift: its crew and the exact sums of its setups, with the bale's scale reading.
tables.name: shifts

tables.label: Shift KPI sums (derived)
tables.meaning: One row per production day, shift and variant of raw numerators and denominators, built once from the tables above; every KPI tile is a ratio of sums of these columns.
tables.name: shift_kpis

tables.label: Customers
tables.meaning: The customer dimension: forty invented customers and C000, the plant itself, for pallet sheets; no measures.
tables.name: customers

tables.label: The reject taxonomy
tables.meaning: One row per reason of the reject taxonomy (reject_reasons.json): its category, family, waste line and the positions it can be recorded at.
tables.name: reject_reasons
